holiday_plan.intro: A four-day Thanksgiving weekend requires Friday, November 27, off as well as Thursday; confirm your own work schedule. These five alternatives stay within roughly a three-hour drive of NYC in normal traffic, not a holiday-traffic guarantee. Prioritize November 27–29 for indoor attractions and meals.

trips.title: Cold Spring: village wandering and Hudson shoreline
trips.why: A car-free combination of village streets, river views and an optional Little Stony Point walk. Keep the outing near the waterfront rather than planning a strenuous summit hike.
trips.transport: Car-free: Metro-North Hudson Line from Grand Central to Cold Spring, then walking. The seasonal Cold Spring trolley does not operate this late in November.
trips.time_budget: A full daylight outing, with time for the train journeys and walking between the village and park.
trips.booking_note: The park publishes daily sunrise-to-sunset access. Breakneck Ridge trailhead, associated trails and its train station are closed for construction; do not substitute that hike. Check the November 26 special timetable if traveling Thursday, and confirm restaurant hours or bring food.

trips.title: Hudson overnight with Olana's new contemporary-art exhibition
trips.why: Combine Hudson's downtown dining and shops with Frederic Church's designed landscape. Laurent Grasso's exhibition opens November 22, placing contemporary film and paintings inside Church's historic house. Suggested stay: November 27–28 or 28–29.
trips.transport: Car-required for the itinerary as proposed. Amtrak to Hudson plus a prearranged round-trip taxi is an alternative, but Olana warns that local taxi and rideshare service is limited.
trips.time_budget: One night and two partial days. Olana estimates a 2.5-hour drive from NYC before holiday delays.
trips.booking_note: Olana currently lists tours Friday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–3:30 p.m., and grounds daily, 8 a.m.–sunset. Reserve the appropriate exhibition or house-tour admission and arrive 30 minutes early. Exact holiday-weekend tour inventory, lodging and restaurant openings remain unconfirmed.
trips.event_name: Metaphysical Maze: Laurent Grasso at Frederic Church's Olana and the Thomas Cole Site

trips.title: Philadelphia: Duchamp and Reading Terminal Market
trips.why: An indoor-heavy art-and-food escape anchored by the Marcel Duchamp retrospective and Reading Terminal Market. November 27–28 is a practical pairing, with the market on Saturday before returning.
trips.transport: Car-free: NJ TRANSIT Northeast Corridor from New York Penn to Trenton, then SEPTA's Trenton Line into Philadelphia. Continue on foot and local transit; the art museum is not beside the intercity station.
trips.time_budget: One night, allowing substantial travel time for the Trenton connection and separate blocks for the museum and market.
trips.booking_note: Duchamp requires a one-hour timed-entry window; its ticket includes museum admission. Published museum hours are Friday 10 a.m.–8:45 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; holiday exceptions were not exposed in the fetched FAQ. Reading Terminal Market explicitly closes November 26; individual merchant hours vary and Pennsylvania Dutch merchants close Sundays. Check both rail operators' date-specific schedules and separate fares.

trips.title: Longwood's cosmic Christmas gardens
trips.why: The 2026 display combines astronomy-inspired conservatory installations, outdoor lights and a garden railway. This is the strongest verified holiday-specific choice for November 26 itself.
trips.transport: Car-required for this proposed outing. Longwood also lists direct OurBus service from NYC, but departures and return service for this particular weekend were not verified.
trips.time_budget: A long afternoon-and-evening outing at the outer edge of the requested driving radius. Longwood lists NYC as 130 miles away; leave additional time for holiday traffic.
trips.booking_note: The official Christmas page lists daily opening, 10 a.m.–11 p.m., throughout the season. Obtain a dated timed-entry ticket before traveling; availability was not checked. A 1906 restaurant reservation is separate. The Main Fountain Garden fountains are not operating this season, and the garden railway is weather-dependent.

trips.title: Jim Thorpe: Victorian streets and a Santa train
trips.why: A Poconos outing combining historic architecture, independent shops and river-gorge scenery from a heritage train. The Santa service makes this particularly suitable for families.
trips.transport: Car-required for this itinerary. Drive to Jim Thorpe and walk between downtown and the railway station at 1 Susquehanna Street; the excursion train is not transportation from NYC.
trips.time_budget: A full day with a substantial drive each way. The operator describes holiday excursions as 80-minute round trips and recommends arriving at least one hour before departure.
trips.booking_note: Santa Claus Specials are listed November 27–29 at 10:30 a.m., 1 p.m. and 3:30 p.m. Check dated tickets before setting out; no availability is implied. Pick up tickets before boarding. Verify parking and Route 209 access notices; earlier-November overflow-lot dates do not establish holiday-weekend service.
trips.event_name: Lehigh Gorge Scenic Railway Santa Claus Specials

local_ideas.title: NYBG Holiday Train Show after dark
local_ideas.why: Botanical models of NYC landmarks, including a new One Vanderbilt model, plus live jazz during explicitly scheduled extended evenings. The Conservatory stays open until 8 p.m., with last entry at 7:15 p.m. Obtain admission for the intended date and session.

local_ideas.title: Bryant Park Winter Village, with optional Club Santa
local_ideas.why: Browse the seasonal shops or reserve skating without leaving Manhattan. Club Santa is specifically scheduled November 28–29 and combines skating, crafts and a Santa visit; every guest entering its lounge needs that separate ticket. Ordinary rink admission is free, but rentals and other services cost extra.

checks: Confirm your own days off; the holiday does not establish employer leave.

Use date-specific outbound and return timetables. Metro-North has published a November 26-only Hudson Line schedule; do not apply it to November 27–29. NJ TRANSIT and SEPTA holiday connections remain unconfirmed.
Check timed admission, cancellation rules, lodging and restaurant openings before committing. No ticket, room or table availability was verified.
Check forecasts, sunset, trail closures and road conditions shortly before departure. Normal-traffic driving distance is a selection boundary, not a promised holiday journey time.

Beacon/Dia and Storm King were starting candidates, but their official visitor pages returned 403 errors. Their holiday hours and admission arrangements remain unconfirmed, so they were replaced rather than presented as verified outings.
Long Island's Old Westbury Gardens explicitly announces closure for Thanksgiving week and weekend. New Jersey's Grounds For Sculpture visitor page was blocked, so neither was used to fill the list.
For Longwood without a car, confirm both OurBus departures and garden admission independently. For Hudson without a car, arrange both taxi legs before relying on the train alternative.

items.title: Le Gratin: $45 lunch and $30 bar entrees
items.summary: Two-course lunch offers a lower-cost introduction to the restaurant. Separately, the bar serves steak, mussels, chicken or steak tartare with fries for $30 during happy hour.
items.price_text: Lunch: two courses $45 or three $55 per person. Happy-hour entrees $30; mini martinis $8 separately.
items.schedule: Lunch Monday–Friday, 11:30am–2:30pm. Happy hour Tuesday–Friday, 5–7pm.
items.conditions: Happy-hour offers are bar-only; walk-ins welcome. The $8 mini martini is separate from the $30 entree. Lunch supplements include steak tartare +$5, skate +$3, cheeseburger +$5 and steak frites +$8. Tax, gratuity and holiday exclusions unstated. Neither offer runs Saturday.
items.verification_note: Official lunch menu confirms prices, supplements and Monday–Friday service: https://legratinnyc.com/our-menu/lunch. Captured experiences page confirms separate martini and entree prices and Tuesday–Friday bar eligibility: https://legratinnyc.com/experiences.
